== Biography ==
Elizabeth was born about 1850 in New Monkland, Lanarkshire, Scotland.  She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-424|John Glasgow]] and [[Forsyth-878|Christina Forsyth]]


In 1851 Elizabeth was living at 37 Aitchison Street New Monkland with her parents, John Glasgow and Christina Fosyth, ,iblings and granny. She is 1 year old.  <ref name = 1851C>
